title: The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.19037v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) > \beta$, not a deployment certificat

translated_title: 批评者也会造成伤害：论 LLM 引导的 AutoML 搜索中批评者的安全性
translated_abstract: LLM 批评者日益被用于在代理式 AutoML、提示优化和自我精炼中引导迭代搜索——人们通常评估它们是否有帮助，却很少评估它们是否会造成伤害。我们通过四臂审计分离出批评者的边际效应，并通过受控故障注入刻画该循环的容错能力。我们证明，一个朴素的 8B 批评者在 8 个表格数据集中的 7 个上使搜索表现低于无批评者时的随机搜索下限，最坏情况下 AUC 损失高达 0.245；损失幅度随数据集、搜索前沿和预算的不同而剧烈变化。何时：更强的批评者在评估的数据套件上能减轻损失，但并未建立起一个普适的能力阈值。为什么：受控故障注入表明，在“保留迄今最优”的搜索机制下，非方向性错误几乎不产生代价，而方向性错误会消耗有限的搜索机会；理想化的有效样本计算给出了必要条件 q(m-1) > β，但这并非部署层面的安全证书。
tldr: 本文首次系统审计了 LLM 批评者在代理式 AutoML 搜索中的安全性，发现朴素的小型批评者可使搜索性能跌破随机搜索下限，并揭示方向性错误因消耗有限的搜索机会是造成伤害的关键机制。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic safety audit of LLM critics in agentic AutoML search, showing that a naive 8B critic can drive search below the no-critic random-search floor, and identifying directional errors—by consuming finite search opportunities—as the key mechanism of harm.
